jobs_results.title: Cybersecurity Intern
jobs_results.description:
Do you want to try a different style of consulting?

Do you want to work in a dynamic and innovative environment? Join Capgemini Invent, the strategic consulting and digital transformation unit of the Capgemini group!

We are looking for ambitious people who want to start their career with us in the field of consulting in technology directions and in the implementation of the most advanced solutions on the market for our clients locally and internationally.

One of the practices with the highest growth potential within the group is Digital Trust (DT).

DT's mission is to help CIOs, CISOs and DPOs to ensure information security by supporting the implementation of new Enterprise and Technology Architectures. We firmly believe that technology and security, together with people, are strategic elements for the competitiveness of organisations.

To support the growth of our practice we are actively looking for professionals who want to develop their professional career in a leading company... in business consulting and digital transformation, bringing value to our clients.

Professional profile:
• Education: preferably Master's or Bachelor's degree in Computer Engineering, Telecommunications, Mathematics or Statistics.
• Previous experience in consultancy is a plus.
• Great knowledge of English, as some of our clients are international.

You will perform functions related to:
• Offensive Security
• Security auditing
• Information security governance
• Definition of strategic security plans
• Definition of KPIs, KRIs, KGIs and support and monitoring scorecards
• Definition and development of security regulatory frameworks
• Security Management Systems, based on ISO27001
• Regulations and reference frameworks: Information Protection (GDPR), PCI-DSS, PSD2, etc.
• Definition of security requirements for developments and services.
• Risk assessment (MAGERIT, OCTAVE, ISO3100, etc).
• Definition and development of training and awareness programmes in Information Security, both for employees and Senior Management.
• Business Continuity Management System (ISO22301)
• You will have the opportunity to obtain different certifications (CISA, CISM, CRISC, CISSP, Data Protection Specialist, ISO27001 Lead Auditor/Implementer, ISO22301 Lead Auditor/Implementer).

By joining Capgemini Invent, you will be part of a bright and talented team. You will have the opportunity to gain exposure to all industry sectors and a better insight into how to define and execute a transformation project for our clients. This, combined with an unbeatable working environment, will propel your career to the next level.

At Capgemini Invent we create the leaders of tomorrow, and we believe you have prepared yourself for this incredible journey with us

jobs_results.title: Cybersecurity Europe Referent
jobs_results.description:
JOB PURPOSE

—

Location: Budapest or Madrid or Varese (Italy)

The Cybersecurity Europe Referent report to Group CISO based in France.

He will be responsible for managing the cybersecurity approach within EMEA geographical perimeter within the organization.

JOB CONTEXT

—

Our Client is Legrand, a prominent multinational company operating in the industrial environment.

Considering the dynamically evolving cyber threat landscape, our client is committed to keep the cybersecurity risk at a controlled level. Consequently, it endorses the deployment of a common Group policy (LISP), in alignment with best industry standards (NIST CSF and ISO 27001/2).

The EU CISO is a key element in Group Cybersecurity organization in ensuring the adoption and implementation of the Cybersecurity policies and processes within its scope. The EU CISO works closely with the Group CISO, the Zones business managers, the Country managers and their Cybersecurity referents, the cybersecurity community... etc.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

—

Strategic Planning and Objective Setting
• Define strategic cybersecurity objectives aligned with Group goals and local regulations.
• Collaborate with management to validate and implement these objectives.
• Engage in continuous assessment and refinement of strategic axes to ensure relevance and effectiveness.

Risk Assessment and Mitigation
• Evaluate local cybersecurity risks comprehensively to identify potential vulnerabilities.
• Develop and implement organizational and technical measures to mitigate identified risks.
• Monitor the effectiveness of implemented measures and adjust strategies as needed to enhance resilience against cyber threats.

Governance and Management Structure Establishment
• Establish robust governance and management structures to oversee security action plans across diverse entities within the organization.
• Foster collaboration and communication among stakeholders to ensure effective implementation and enforcement of security measures.
• Provide guidance and support to local teams in adhering to established cybersecurity protocols and procedures.

Incident Management and Crisis Response
• Play a pivotal role in managing security incidents and mitigating the impact of potential crises.
• Lead coordinated responses to security breaches, involving relevant stakeholders and executing predefined action plans.
• Continuously improve incident response processes based on lessons learned and emerging threats to enhance organizational resilience.

Community Engagement and Reporting
• Actively engage with the EMEA cybersecurity community to foster a culture of awareness and collaboration.
• Enhance reporting mechanisms to facilitate transparent communication of cybersecurity compliance progress.
• Support countries in understanding and aligning with cybersecurity objectives and processes, fostering a cohesive approach to risk management and mitigation.

SPECIFIC SKILLS

—
• Fluent in English
• Willingness to travel internationally within the requirements of the position
• University degree in the field of computer science or equivalent OR a university degree in Communication and Change Management or equivalent with a high appetency on technology topics
• Specialized knowledge of cybersecurity.
• In-depth knowledge of Information Systems.
• In-depth knowledge of security technologies and related tools.
• Ability to interact with business lines and understand the organization's challenges.
• In-depth knowledge of governance, norms and standards in the field of security: ISO standards (2700X), NIST CSF, Risk Management.

EXPERIENCE

—
• Related work experience in IT related positions with at least 5 years experience in Cybersecurity Governance
• Significant experience acquired in a multinational environment, preferably in a matrix structure
• Experience in ITIL based organizations
• Proven track record in security related positions

jobs_results.title: Técnico de Ciberseguridad
jobs_results.description:
Requisitos
• Experiencia demostrable de al menos 3 años en la gestión y administración de firewalls (Fortinet, Palo Alto), gestión de soluciones EDR de protección del puesto de trabajo, gestión de DNS, gestión de acceso seguro a la red, acceso VPN, etc.

Conocimientos:

Conocimientos avanzados en:
• Seguridad. Se requerirá certificaciones CompTIA Security+, PCNSA, Fortinet NSE4
• Soluciones Cortex XDR. Se requerirá certificación Cortex XDR: Prevention, Analysis, and Response
• Herramientas SIEM

Conocimientos:
• Soluciones de doble factor de autenticación
• Herramientas del CCN (Lucía, micro-Claudia, Gloria, Rocío)

Funciones
• Apoyo en la gestión de vulnerabilidades
• Monitorización de alertas de seguridad
• Operación de sistemas EDR
• Respuesta a incidentes
• Gestión de indicadores de compromiso
• Automatización de acciones de respuesta

Se valorará:
• Posibilidad de incorporación inmediata

jobs_results.title: Cybersecurity Operations Professional
jobs_results.description:
It takes the brightest minds to be a technology leader. It takes imagination to create green energy for the generations to come. At Siemens Gamesa we make real what matters, join our global team.

Siemens Gamesa has a vision for renewable energy: we believe in the power of nature and technology. Help us to be ready to face the energy challenges of tomorrow and make a green footprint – join the team in creating a better future for us on our planet.

We focus on hiring the best people, wherever they may be in the world. We pride ourselves on the flexibility we offer to our employees and are committed to building a workforce that can grow with the company. Siemens Gamesa is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

In our culture of trust, we focus on empowerment, diversity and continuous learning. Valuing our people is what makes us one global team, with our colleagues’ safety at the heart of our... organization.

How To Contribute To Our Vision
• Identifies and analyzes information security goals, objectives and needs of the business environment in the assigned Siemens Gamesa IT Cybersecurity Operations areas of responsibility.
• Implements Siemens Gamesa IT Cybersecurity Operations strategy plans based on sound IT Cybersecurity Operations Standards and processes.
• Ensures professional and effective communication with Siemens Gamesa business partners to ensure Cybersecurity incidents and vulnerabilities are handled effectively.
• Ensures effective communication and coordination of Siemens Gamesa IT and Siemens Gamesa IT contractors to achieve IT Cybersecurity Operations objectives.
• Ensures the Cybersecurity Operations - SOC processes are operating effectively keeping Siemens Gamesa Risk level in an acceptable level.
• Ensure the IT Cybersecurity Operations capabilities: people, processes and technologies are operating effectively.
• Coordinate and enable the effective implementation of the IT Cybersecurity Operations framework MitreAtt&ck ensuring use cases and playbooks achieve the goals in the Siemens Gamesa IT and business environment.
• Ensure Siemens Gamesa IT Cybersecurity operations threat intelligence processes are operating effectively jointly with the SOC operations and the vulnerability management processes.
• Advice Siemens Gamesa IT Cybersecurity operations partners with actionable solutions to mitigate identified IT Cybersecurity risks within the IT Cybersecurity incidents.
• Prepare reports to the Siemens Gamesa IT Cybersecurity department and partners when required
• Contributes and supports planning, budgeting, design and alignment of information security processes and IT environment.
• Prepare, plan and provide Cybersecurity advisories or trainings
• Analyzes and evaluates trends and developments in IT Cybersecurity area with special focus in IT Cybersecurity Operations.
• Typically reports to an IT Manager or Team Leader and the CISO/ISO of the same unit.
• The skilled Cybersecurity Operations professional will be part of team in the IT Cybersecurity Operations organization and will have the operational responsibility of ensuring the Cybersecurity Operations processes - SOC are operating effectively following the objectives defined by the IT Cybersecurity Operations Manager.

What You Need To Make a Difference

Passion for renewable energy and a sense for the importance to lead the change. We are also looking for…
• SIEM tools, Knowledge of MitreAtt&ck Framework
• Microsoft Windows and Linux Systems
• Antivirus - EDR tools
• Microsoft Azure and Security tools
• SANS trainings (Monitoring and detection, Penetration testing, Cyber defense Operations)
• Fluent in English (C1) and Spanish (C1)

In return of your commitment we offer you
• Become a part of our mission for sustainability: Clean energy for generations to come
• A global team of diverse colleagues who share passion for renewable energy
• Trust and empowerment to make your own ideas reality
• Personal and professional development to grow internally within our organization
• Flexible working hours as well as home-office
• Attractive remuneration package
• Local benefits such as subsided lunch, employee discounts and much more

Empowering our people

https://www.siemensgamesa.com/sustainability/employees

How do you imagine the future?

https://youtu.be/12Sm678tjuY

Our global team is on the front line of tackling the climate crisis, reducing carbon emissions – the greatest challenge we face.

Severely disabled applicants are encouraged to reach out to us. We have inclusive recruiting processes specifically for severely disabled persons in Germany and we do our utmost to tailor working spaces to suit your individual needs. In cases of severe disability, applicants who are equally qualified will be given preferential consideration.

Siemens Gamesa is an equal opportunity employer and maintains a work environment that is free from discrimination and where employees are treated with dignity and respect. Employment at Siemens Gamesa is based solely on an individual's merit and qualifications, which are directly related to job competence. Siemens Gamesa does not discriminate against any employee or job applicant on the basis of race, ethnicity, nationality, ancestry, genetic information, citizenship, religion, age, gender, gender identity/expression, sexual orientation, pregnancy, marital status, disability or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws, rules or regulations. We adhere to these principles in all aspects of employment, including recruiting, hiring, training, compensation, promotion and benefits.

We are driven by people - from more than 100 different countries, they build the company we are every day. Our diverse and inclusive culture encourages us to think outside the box, speak without fear, and be bold. We value the flexibility that our smart-working arrangements, our digital disconnection framework and our family-friendly practices bring to the new way of working

jobs_results.title: Cyber Security Specialist
jobs_results.description:
Desde Logicalis Spain queremos incorporar un perfil de Cyber Security Specialist para incorporarse en uno de nuestros clientes.

Funciones a realizar:

- Experiencia en seguridad en cloud.

- Análisis, KPIs, OKRs relativos a ciberseguridad.

- Experiencia y conocimientos DevSecOps.

- Amplia experiencia en la gestión de herramientas de seguridad activa y pasiva tales como Firewalls, EDRs, SIEM, Gestión de claves, IDS/IPS, etc..

- Gestión de la seguridad en redes de comunicaciones.

- Respuesta a incidentes.

- Colaboración en el desarrollo de instrucciones técnicas, procedimientos y registros de seguridad.

- Conocimiento de los principales estándares de seguridad.

- Certificación CISSP, CompTIA Security+, o similar deseable.

- Detectar, analizar y gestionar el ciclo de vida de las vulnerabilidades.

- Conocimientos y experiencia en gestión de tecnologías colaterales como SOAP, REST web services, AD, LDAP, OAuth, WAF, programación básica, etc.

Se valorará positivamente:

... Experiencia en gestión de proyectos tecnológicos.

- Virtualización y contenedores.

- Experiencia y conocimientos en auditorías de seguridad y sistemas.

- Conocimientos en metodologías Scrum/Agile.

- Marcos de seguridad técnicos como OWASP API top 10, DSOVS, etc.

- Conocimientos en la gestión y tratamiento de riesgo tecnológico.

¿Qué ofrecemos en Logicalis Spain?

Logicalis Spain somos un grupo internacional con más de 20 años de experiencia en el sector IT, vinculados a proyectos y servicios de gran envergadura en Data Centers, Ciberseguridad y Analytics.

• Puesto de trabajo estable. Proyectos de larga duración.

• Modalidad de trabajo 100% remoto

• Jornada intensiva todos los viernes, julio y agosto.

• Festivo el día de tu cumpleaños.

• Posibilidad de acceder a planes de retribución flexible (tarjeta restarurante, tarjeta transporte).

• Seguro Médico Privado, GymPass

• Importantes descuentos en diferentes servicios y formaciones por ser empleado de Logicalis, (retail, electrónica, viajes..).

• Formación y certificaciones adaptadas a tu puesto de trabajo.

• Desarrollo profesional con proyectos punteros y tecnologías actuales en el mercado

jobs_results.title: Experto/a Esquema Nacional de Seguridad (ENS) - Ciberseguridad
jobs_results.description:
Desde el equipo de Ciberseguridad de NTT Data, nos gustaría incorporar a profesionales con experiencia en Esquema Nacional de Seguridad.

¿Cuál será tu misión?

Colaborar en procesos de implantación, auditoría y/o certificación en el Esquema Nacional de Seguridad (ENS).

¿Cuáles son los requisitos de la posición?
• Experiencia de más de 5 años en la misión descrita anteriormente.
• Tener un background tecnológico.
• Conocimientos en herramientas de GRC.
• Experiencia en la elaboración y defensa de oferta de ENS.
• Experiencia en la elaboración de planes de formación de ENS y otros estándares de seguridad.

Y, ¿requisitos valorables?
• Conocimiento en ISO 27001, COBIT, ISO 22301
• Experiencia en Esquema Nacional de Interoperabilidad (ENI)

Pero, ¿qué te ofrecemos nosotros?
• Trabajar en equipos con profesionales especializados.
• Un ambiente de trabajo basado en el compañerismo, la cercanía y la confianza.
• Plan de desarrollo individualizado, que permita evolucionar tu carrera... profesional hacia tus aspiraciones.
• Evolución de carrera orientado a resultados y basado en el plan de desarrollo personal.
• Trabajar con tecnologías punteras en el mercado.
• Posibilidad de formación, certificaciones y aprendizaje enfocado en las funciones y el plan de desarrollo.
• Flexibilidad y conciliación
• Paquete de beneficios sociales añadido a tu salario bruto anual.

¡Te esperamos!

En NTT DATA creemos que toda persona es única y diferente y por ello apostamos por una cultura inclusiva que reconoce y valora la diversidad. Trabajamos día a día para crear un entorno en el que podamos explorar, vivir y potenciar nuestra propia singularidad.

#WeAreAllUnique #YouMakeUsUnique

jobs_results.title: Cybersecurity Professional (m/f/d) "Collaboration Services" in the...
jobs_results.description:
A passion for security.

Our cyber security specialists are true professionals in terms of thinking creatively. They explore every possibility when it comes to effective ways of deceiving, circumventing, and weakening IT systems so that they can protect them even more successfully. To this end, they ask questions that have no answers yet and look for gaps where hardly anyone would suspect them. This is essential for digitalization! Join our team, and we will foster your continuing professional development and an exchange with colleagues from all over the world.

As a Cybersecurity Professional for "Collaboration Services" in the Microsoft M365 environment you will drive and develop security initiatives and roadmaps in close collaboration with the IT service-owners and vendors to address the organization's cyber security needs and meet business demands.

What are my responsibilities?
• Contribute cybersecurity aspects to new and existing Collaboration Services in the M365 environment... (with a solid focus on SharePoint, OneDrive, and Teams), provided by IT, vendors, or providers. Identifying security issues, evaluating security risks, and recommending strong protection solutions in your area of expertise
• Provide guidance regarding the potential use of Microsoft 365 applications and 3rd party applications
• Team up with IT workload owners and CYS platform architects to develop IT infrastructure and architectures including CYS concepts to deliver cybersecurity resilient services
• Bridge the gap between technical specialists and management level by a transparent risk management approach. You clearly assess risks and derive appropriate measures to reduce identified risks to an acceptable level
• Provide technical insights and recommendations to enhance cybersecurity posture to the Chief Cyber Security Officer
• Query and handle your IT-internal customer on all cybersecurity aspects vital to implement a security/protection concept and keep security measures in place (e.g., exception handling, vulnerability remediation, penetration test planning, change requests)
• Lead and participate in task forces to address cybersecurity projects and incidents, working closely with partners such as CERT teams and business providers. Communicate effectively with and prepare decision papers for the collaborators
• Offer support to IT and business teams within projects, ensuring efficiency and operational excellence in cybersecurity aspects
• Act as an advocate for best practices in cybersecurity, particularly concerning Microsoft M365

What do I need to qualify for this job?
• University degree in computer science, IT security or related fields or equivalent
• Long-term experience in IT with focus on cybersecurity especially regarding Cloud SaaS Solutions, Microsoft 365 and Infrastructure topics
• Knowledge of cybersecurity standards such as ISO27001 and NIST. Certificates like e.g. CISSP, CISM, CCSP, and corresponding Microsoft certifications are a plus
• Experience in protection of Collaboration Services (e.g., MS Teams, Concept board, SharePoint, Messaging, Telephony)
• Experience in securing Microsoft 365 tenant, service architecture and B2B scenario. Especially experience in collaboration services like MS Stream, Microsoft Teams, SharePoint, OneDrive, Exchange, and telephony and messaging
• Additional experience in Azure, Dynamics, and Power Platform would be helpful
• Experience in project coordination and consultancy roles, preferably with international exposure
• Strong problem-solving and superb communication skills, both verbal and written, with fluency in English
• Attention to detail and the ability to work multi-functionally in a team environment
• Solution oriented thinking, remarkable analytical skills, and excellent team working is required

What we offer.
• 2 to 3 days of mobile working per week as a global standard
• Attractive remuneration package
• Development opportunities for both personal and professional growth
• A variety of flexible working models that allow time off for yourself and your family
• Appealing working atmosphere. At Siemens, we are dedicated to fostering an inclusive workplace where diversity is embraced and all individuals are empowered to succeed
• Share matching programs to become a shareholder of Siemens AG
• Find more benefits here

Individual benefits are adapted to meet local legal regulations, the requirements of different job profiles, locations, and individual preferences.

Make your mark in our exciting world at Siemens!

As an equal-opportunity employer we are happy to consider applications from individuals with disabilities.

www.siemens.com/careers - if you would like to find out more about jobs & careers at Siemens.

FAQ - if you need further information on the application process.

Please send your CV in English so it can be reviewed

jobs_results.title: Cybersecurity Workstream Lead
jobs_results.description:
Together, we move the world, and we want you to be a part of it. In MAHLE you will have the opportunity to work in one of the most powerful multinationals in the automotive sector, with great opportunities for professional development and surrounded by a multicultural environment with colleagues who share your passion for technology and mobility.

As a Cybersecurity Workstream Lead in MAHLE you will work through all phases of product development following the required procedures to ensure our quality standard and looking for continuous improvement ideas.

How can you become part of our success?
• Ensure implementation of defined Cybersecurity Engineering Management System (CSMS) by mentoring, support and training of affected development and other teams
• Improving the CSMS by incorporating feedback and lessons learned from the development projects
• Support organizational cybersecurity activities e.g. continual monitoring, incident management and audit
• Manage necessary resources... with support of the program manager
• Functional leadership of the workstream team

What skills do you need?
• Degree in Computer Science/ Electronics/ Electrical/ Telecommunications Engineering or similar.
• Minimum 5 years’ experience working in cybersecurity, software development or embedded system development.
• Analytical skills with a solution and action-oriented mentality. and “make it happen” mindset.
• High communication skills across multicultural and multidisciplinary teams.
• Emphatic, resilient and patient
• Driver and result oriented. Proactive
• Knowledge in cybersecurity regulation UN R155 and standards such as ISO/ SAE 21434, ISO 2700x.
• Experience with automotive standards/guidelines (AUTOSAR, ASPICE, ISO 26262) is an advantage.
• Fluent in English (C1) is required and Spanish will be valued.

What does MAHLE offer you?
• Attractive salary package.
• We will oversee all the administrative process for candidates who come from abroad.
• Flexible work schedule and possible working from home solution (home office).
• Continuous training.
• Becoming a member of a fast-growing team in an innovative company with stable market position.
• Possibility to work for a well-known brand, a leader in Automotive industry whose products are highly recognized worldwide.
• Be part of a team in a multicultural environment with a fantastic working environment.

If you do not comply with all the requirements, don't worry, we still want to meet you! Don’t hesitate and apply to our offer - exciting opportunities and challenges for your career are awaiting you.

MAHLE Electronics is committed to creating an inclusive work environment with a diverse workforce. All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to race, religion, gender, sexual orientation, place of origin, disability, or age.

Do you have any questions?

[[sara.martinez@mahle.com

jobs_results.title: Cybersecurity Technical Specialist - Lynx
jobs_results.description:
Country: Spain

Lynx Financial Crime Tech is looking for a Cybersecurity Technical Specialist, based in our Lynx office in Madrid.

WHY YOU SHOULD CONSIDER THIS OPPORTUNITY

Lynx Financial Crime Tech S.A. We are an AI-driven software company specializing in detecting and predicting behavioral patterns. Led by industry experts and academics, we develop and implement cutting-edge, self-learning AI technologies. Our platform excels in low latency transaction processing technologies and is available both on-premise and on the cloud.

We prioritize VISION, AGILITY, and SPEED to provide outstanding customer experiences and have built long-lasting, trustworthy relationships with some of the top financial institutions, fintechs, and commercial enterprises worldwide.

What You Will Be Doing

As a Cybersecurity Technical Specialist you will part of the Cyber team in Lynx, ensuring that the cybersecurity posture and controls are effectively protecting company’s information and systems with a... 360º view.

We need someone like you to help us in different fronts:
• Ensure deployment of cybersecurity tools and protections.
• Manage cyber solutions and tools to effectively handle potential cybersecurity threats.
• Enforce security configurations across Lynx systems, communications, and architecture.
• Coordinate vulnerability identification activities and track remediation.
• Advise and assess Lynx’s software product areas in terms of cyber.
• Propose and deploy new solutions and capabilities.
• Manage and handle cybersecurity incidents.
• Collaborate within the cyber certification processes (PCI-DSS, ISO27001…).

Experience
• 6+ years of experience cybersecurity operations or similar positions.

EDUCATION
• Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science or Telecommunications

Skills & Knowledge
• Experience in cybersecurity controls and best practices.
• Experience with cybersecurity solutions such as EDR, DLP, vulnerability assessment tools (Qualys), firewalls, IDS/IPS.
• Knowledge in threat analysis and incident response.
• Knowledge in computer forensics.
• Knowledge in Cloud (AWS) security and architecture.
• Knowledge in Linux environments, virtualization, and container security.
• Analytical mindset with the ability to interpret complex data and identify security threats.
• Advanced level in English.

Other Information
• Cybersecurity certifications is a plus (CISSP, OSCP, CEH, GCIH…).
• Experience in the financial/banking industry.

If you want to know more about us, visit our website https://lynxtech.com

jobs_results.title: Cybersecurity Subject Matter Expert | PROTECT
jobs_results.description:
More cybersecure. More proximity. More SIA.

Somos la empresa especializada en Ciberseguridad líder de España y Portugal del Grupo INDRA, siendo expertos en servicios de ingeniería de detección y consultoría de ciberseguridad, contando además con más de 1500 especialistas como talento experto.

Líderes globales de ciberseguridad, protegiendo los activos digitales y nuestros negocios de forma segura. La combinación de un equipo profesional con capacidades únicas en el mercado y la tecnología más avanzada garantizan la excelencia en los servicios que prestamos para lograr un mundo más ciberseguro.

¿Qué esperamos por tu parte?

Estamos en búsqueda de un experto/a en ciberseguridad N3, con experiencia relevante en servicios de Prevent, Detect o Respond que quiera tener su residencia en Bilbao:

Experiencia en proyectos de implantación de soluciones de seguridad, principalmente:
• Akamai, AWS (seguridad) y Splunk/chronicle.
• Elaboración de casos de uso, gestión de alertas y definición de... procedimientos.
• Gestión de incidentes u obtención de información de threat intelligence.
• Asimismo, debe tener experiencia en la gestión de equipos, interlocución a alto nivel con cliente y tener capacidad investigadora

Formación requerida:

- Ingeniería informática o Grado Superior.

IDIOMAS:

- Nivel fluido de inglés.

Motivos por los que te encantará ir más allá de la ciberseguridad #BeyondCybersecurity
• Conciliación y equilibrio: 22 días laborables de descanso.
• Carrera profesional y formación continua adaptada a tus necesidades y motivaciones.
• Contrato indefinido y retribución competitiva, con acceso a planes de retribución flexible.
• Programa de bienestar con acceso a una red de gimnasios, servicio de telemedicina en línea gratuita y otras ventajas.

Sia, Beyond diversity

Nuestro compromiso es promover ambientes de trabajo en los que se trate con respeto y dignidad a las personas, procurando el desarrollo profesional de la plantilla y garantizando la igualdad de oportunidades en su selección, formación y promoción ofreciendo un entorno de trabajo libre de cualquier discriminación por motivo de género, edad, discapacidad, orientación sexual, identidad o expresión de género, religión, etnia, estado civil o cualquier otra circunstancia personal o social.

Te esperamos en SIA
